candidate.predictor: latest fully observed self-contained trailing 168H daily-B1 sleeve net payoff over q=t-169 through t-2, ending at observed open_t
candidate.turnover_in_label: start from cash plus internal absolute B1 changes plus terminal liquidation to cash
candidate.weekly_size: 1.0 if lagged payoff > 0, else 0.5; fallback 1.0 before first complete payoff
candidate.target: daily B1 times carried weekly size

comparators.fixed_half_control: B1 before activation and 0.5 times B1 thereafter
comparators.exposure_matched_control: B1 before activation and constant multiplier thereafter matching adaptive OOS equivalent exposure

acceptance: all per-market economic, breadth, concentration, residual, uncertainty, full-sample and constant-control gates plus common-index lower bounds
